resources.string: VR stereo viewer. Double tap to recenter; long press for settings.
Join the same trusted Wi-Fi, then enter the computer IP and six-digit pairing code.

Use a data USB cable. Enable USB debugging and approve this computer, then open both apps. Connect here or start streaming on the PC. The PC detects the authorized USB phone; no IP or pairing code entry is needed.
USB is selected. Tap Connect through USB, or connect from the PC app.
Waiting for the USB PC app, for up to 30 seconds. Approve USB debugging and keep both apps open. Connect starts a new request; Cancel stops the current request.
USB host not detected. Check the data cable, enable USB debugging, approve this computer, and start PC streaming. Tap Detect USB and connect to retry.
USB access is not ready. Approve USB debugging on this phone, then check that the PC app detects this authorized USB device and start streaming.
The PC app is reachable but streaming is stopped. Connect here, or start streaming on the PC and retry.
USB discovery failed. Update both apps to the same version, start PC streaming and retry.
USB uses the authorized data-cable connection. First-person gyro mouse control uses the PC setting, enabled by default. Press F8 on the PC to stop control; Resume on the PC restores it.
Check the USB data cable, debugging authorization and PC streaming
Link round trip: waiting for connection · not video latency
Link round trip: %1$d ms · not end-to-end video latency
Phone processing: waiting for video · not total video latency
Phone processing: %1$.1f ms mean · receive to texture submission; excludes PC, link and display
Video and controls are unencrypted. Use a trusted LAN. First-person gyro mouse control uses the PC setting, enabled by default. Press F8 on the PC to stop control; Resume on the PC restores it.
No rotation sensor detected. Full and Enhanced first person displays remain available; Cinema and ordinary First-person are disabled. Gyro mouse control is unavailable.
0% keeps the original movement. Higher values reduce shake and may add smoothing delay. Applied on the computer.
This computer app does not support stabilization yet. Your value is saved on the phone; update the PC app to apply it.

Inside either eye: drag outward to separate images, inward until their edges meet; up/down moves both. Corners resize proportionally. Near the seam, position and spacing adjust automatically. Flat preview; head controls paused.
Each eye stays square. Drag inside to move the images symmetrically; inward can join their edges. Corners resize proportionally. The wide-angle warp remains visible; head controls are paused.
All phone settings reset: VR defaults, English and USB. Reconnect to send the defaults to the PC.
The PC did not send a valid VRization handshake. Update both apps and connect again.

Full and First-person use a fixed image for both eyes. Cinema places the 2D desktop in virtual space. Enhanced first person maps the entire desktop into a square per eye with curved wide-angle projection. Both first-person modes use the same gyro mouse controls. This is not native stereoscopic game rendering or VR180. Audio stays on the computer.\nEntering the background disconnects video and stops control. Use the connection button after returning.

Enhanced first person: fixed 1:1 per eye, proportional scale and mirrored movement. Field of view adjusts the GPU warp (default 80°); curved corners are black. It reshapes the existing picture, without adding scene detail.
This PC app uses ordinary First-person controls for compatibility. The phone keeps its enhanced square display and saved choice; update the PC app for enhanced mode synchronization.
